content.about: Palau is a nation of about 340 islands in the western Pacific. It has coral reefs and rock islands. It created a large shark sanctuary. Visitors sign an eco pledge.

standout.text: Palau's Jellyfish Lake is home to millions of stingless golden jellyfish.

didYouKnow: Palau created one of the first shark sanctuaries.
Rock Islands are a UNESCO site.
